tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A detailed description of the essential technical and performance characteristics of the goods.

A list giving full particulars, including available sources and current prices, of spare parts, special tools, etc., necessary for the proper and continuing functioning of the goods for a period of two years, following commencement of the use of the goods by the Purchaser.

The intending bidder should have supplied of Coal handling spares/Pipes to power plant/power utilities/any process industries/Thermal power plants/reputed organization in a single purchase order of value not less than Rs.3.26/- Lakhs issued in the preceding five financial years (2021-2022, 2022-23, 2023-24 2024-25 and 2025-26. As a proof bidder shall upload the original scanned PO copy.

The intending bidder shall be a Manufacturer/Authorized Dealer/Supplier of Coal handling spares/Pipes to power plant/power plant/any process industries. As a proof the bidder shall upload a valid registration certificate issued by competent authority in case of manufacturer & dealership certificate from manufacturer in case of authorized dealers.

The intending bidder in his name should have achieved an average annual financial turnover of Rs.6.52/- Lakhs for any two years during the last five years. As a proof, the bidder shall upload the certified copy of the Profit and Loss account or turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered Accountant.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder shall have GST registrations & shall furnish copy of certificate as documentary proof.
The declaration duly signed in the prescribed format (Annexure - II) has to be enclosed.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Turnover Certificate or profit and loss statement
